horizon_risk.caveat: Reduced to 200 Monte Carlo paths (vs. the retired 6-leg script's 2000) for runtime reasons -- disclosed, not hidden; see project_wheel_v1_horizon_risk.py's own module docstring. This is the FIRST run of this exact Monte Carlo methodology at Primary sizing -- it has not been iterated/cross-checked across multiple runs the way the old script was over time. Read alongside, not instead of, the reconciled REAL backtest numbers: $23,068,549.17 final / 363.46% CAGR / -47.5% MDD over the real 4-year window, $46,849,145.26 / 212.90% CAGR / -60.6% MDD over the real 6-year window (Policy B + Primary sizing, never derisks). Pre-Primary (2026-10-27, T1=70%, W_MNQ/W_MGC unscaled) real numbers ($4,015,457.63/199.36%/-41.1%/4yr, $14,013,277.60/155.87%/-54.6%/6yr) and the original permanent-derisk policy's own real numbers ($939,296.63/108.19%/-28.2%/4yr T1=30%, $2,372,248.48/162.45%/-30.0%/4yr T1=70%; $1,479,308.37/75.89%/-27.3%/6yr T1=30%, $6,354,608.73/124.27%/-36.8%/6yr T1=70%) remain retained comparison benchmarks. Primary sizing was adopted after a corrected 1,000-path margin-enforced, execution-cost-inclusive Monte Carlo study (see memory wheel_t1_priority_margin_allocation_2026_10_28.md) found 3.0x/2.0x MNQ/MGC weight scaling raises 6yr median terminal wealth from $2.36M to $4.26M (with T1-priority margin allocation, not yet live -- see that memory's own open items) while raising observed severe-loss frequency (>=70% of original capital) only to 0.1-0.2% -- an observed bootstrap frequency, not a calibrated forward probability. Note the much larger MDD figures here vs. the retained permanent-derisk benchmarks are the direct, expected cost of removing that switch -- not a new finding, the known tradeoff that was explicitly accepted when adopting Policy B. T1-priority margin allocation itself (above) went live 2026-10-28 as a static, conservative margin reserve ($18,000, T1's fixed real order_qty x MNQ maintenance margin) subtracted from the equity basis MNQ/MGC size off in the LIVE engine (wheel_v1_shadow_engine.advance_one_session) -- deliberately NOT applied to this script's own simulate_ladder_path benchmark (shared by several closed research scripts whose own hard-gates this change did not touch), so these horizon figures run slightly LARGER than true live sizing by a small, shrinking-over-time amount (the $18,000 reserve is a meaningful fraction of today's equity, negligible once equity reaches the millions). An apocalypse kill switch (APOCALYPSE_FLOOR_FRAC=0.75) also went live 2026-10-28 in advance_one_session, same scope-limiting precedent -- NOT applied to this script's own simulate_ladder_path benchmark either, so these horizon figures do not reflect it. A 1000-path, 72mo Monte Carlo scan on the margin-enforced research model (same memory file) found 0.75 is the tightest threshold that eliminates BOTH insolvency and P(lose>=70%) entirely for Primary-T1 (both 0.20%->0.00%), at a real median-wealth cost (-21%, $4.26M->$3.36M over 6yr in that model) this script's own benchmark numbers above do NOT include -- read them as an upper bound on wealth, not the true risk-adjusted live expectation, until this script is itself ported to include the switch. A follow-up leverage-increase scan (3.0x/2.0x up to 5.0x/4.0x, switch active) found no median-wealth benefit from leverage beyond the current Primary weights -- confirmed those stay unchanged.
horizon_risk.policy: Wheel v1.0, "Wheel Policy B, Primary sizing" (active since 2026-10-28, adopted after a corrected 1,000-path margin-survival/execution-cost Monte Carlo study -- see memory wheel_t1_priority_margin_allocation_2026_10_28.md): T1=70%, D2 reversible leverage ladder (3x/4x/5x/6x, 15% hysteresis), MNQ/MGC weights scaled 3.0x/2.0x over the prior (2026-10-27) T1=70%-era values -- the PERMANENT $500k->C30-B derisk switch remains REMOVED; the ladder holds at its own top rung (6x) indefinitely for any equity beyond 16x-of-start. Prior policies retained as comparison benchmarks, not deleted -- see wheel_v1_shadow_engine.py's LEGACY_* constants (LEGACY_DERISK_TRIGGER, LEGACY_T1_WEIGHT/W_MNQ/W_MGC for the T1=30% point, LEGACY_W_MNQ_SOLO/LEGACY_W_MGC_SOLO for the pre-Primary T1=70% sizing).
